summary.text: In Cabal City on Otaria, Chainer discovers the Mirari, rises through the Cabal and takes control of it, befriending Kamahl along the way.
He loses control of the dementia creatures, which overrun the city, and is corrupted by drawing them into himself, and the Mirari overwhelms him.
Chainer begs Kamahl to kill him, and Kamahl tearfully does so and takes the Mirari as promised.
